verdict.rationale: Digits documents an 'Agentic Close' workflow that starts reconciliation before month-end, generates accrual/depreciation schedules from ledger activity, runs quality-control checks, and surfaces exceptions with context, plus 11 dedicated closing quality checks — covering reconciliations, accruals, and QC review. However, there is no explicit documentation of a checklist UI or formal review/sign-off tracking (who approved what, sign-off status) as the story specifies. Missing for 10: an explicit close checklist artifact and documented sign-off/approval tracking mechanism.
